title: New Kamailio Module: NATS
html:
Recently Emmanuel Schmidbauer pushed a new module to Kamailio git repository named nats, which allows to connect to NATS (https://nats.io – the distributed messaging system) and consume messages using queue groups.

A blog post with more details about how to use the new module has been published by the author at:

  • https://blog.voipxswitch.com/2021/07/02/kamailio-nats-module/

The README of the module in html format is available at:

  • https://www.kamailio.org/docs/modules/devel/modules/nats.html

Enjoy!

Thanks for flying Kamailio!
